title: Keep only Russian letters
prompt:
Write `OnlyCyrillic(s string) string` that removes everything except letters of the Russian alphabet (upper and lower case). A regular expression is the expected tool.

`"Hello, Мир! 123 ёлка"` → `"Мирёлка"`
hint: `а-я` doesn't include `ё`, and `\p{Cyrillic}` includes letters Russian doesn't have.
